followup_reviews.Researcher: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root (baseline half) and /root/verification_recovery (programme-addition half); prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/rounds_protocol challenges baseline; /root challenges programme additions; separate same-model contexts with prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the formal network-restoration phase and separate observed Tiptala trader passage. A network announcement and a named crossing observation are not additive independent closure events; potential programme overlap with Korala remains disclosed. P1 concerns seven immediate traditional points in six districts, with other openings staged and point-specific eligibility unresolved. P2 concerns thirty local Nepali traders entering China through Tiptala. Neither supports fourteen universally operational gates. P1 retains 25 May 2024 as a formal decision endpoint, not an observed operational reopening. P2 retains actual trader passage on 24 May, with the cached dated RSS extract establishing the year missing from the fresh extraction. Both onsets and continuity remain unknown; planned ten-day trading visits are not closure durations. The reported initial COVID explanation supports human disease control. It is not extended to every later delay or all traditional points for all intervening days. The ministry PDF fresh attempt timed out, leaving its old indexed extract at the same access level. Tiptala was freshly read; the Radio Nepal extract, Kathmandu Post and Xinhua passages were cached. Conflicting seven/fourteen counts are retained, and shared ministerial/RSS origins are not multiplied. P1 remains unlocated because its seven immediate gates are not individually identified. P2 matches OSM Tipta La node 990378815 at 27.8157775 / 87.7352531, with Tiptala aliases and membership in the NH02 approach way. Do not transfer this point to the whole network or outline the entire frontier.
